shared_elements: upright standing stone slab/monolith as the carved surface
horizontal register of repeated rounded/looped motifs in a row
band of zigzag or triangular pattern running beneath that row
rows of small dots/dashes or beaded borders
framed rectangular panel set into the upper part of the stone
justification: The most specific correspondence is the stacked scheme of a horizontal row of repeated curved, loop-topped forms sitting directly above a band of zigzags/triangles and beaded dot lines, set within a panel on an upright stone. Against this, A is a three-dimensional relief crowded with figural animals, a crouching human and birds below the band — none of which appear in B, which is a flat linear ink drawing of a purely ornamental, symmetrical panel on a rounded stone, so the rendering and overall silhouette are quite unlike.
